mapper.sql: create_time , update_time, bool_delete_enum, version, id, name, date, project_id, sort, remark
mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM plan_monomer WHERE bool_delete_enum = 0
and project_id = #{projectId}
AND name LIKE concat('%',#{name},'%')
order by sort ASC

select pc.* from contract_project_content_link as pcl, contract_project_content as pc
where pc.id = pcl.project_content_id and pc.no!=null and pc.no > 0 and pcl.project_id = #{projectId} and pc.bool_delete_enum = false and pcl.bool_delete_enum = false order by pc.no asc

select pd.product_type as type, pc.name as name from plan_area as pd, contract_project_content as pc
where pd.monomer_id = #{monomerId} and pd.product_type = pc.no
and pd.bool_delete_enum = 0 and pc.bool_delete_enum = 0 order by pd.product_type asc

SELECT MIN(start_date) min_date , MAX(end_date) max_date FROM plan_monomer WHERE bool_delete_enum = 0
AND project_id = #{projectId}
SELECT id, user_id FROM plan_monomer WHERE id NOT IN ( SELECT monomer_id FROM sys_monomer_user_link WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND bool_delete_enum =0) AND project_id = #{projectId};

select ifnull( sum(b.mete), 0 ) as ton from plan_monomer a left join plan_monomer_detail b on b.bool_delete_enum = 0 and a.id = b.monomer_id where a.bool_delete_enum = 0 and date_format(a.create_time, '%Y') = date_format(CURDATE(), '%Y')
